titleDv: ޤާނޫނު ނަންބަރު 8/2009 (ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޕެންޝަނާބެހޭ ޤާނޫނު) އަށް ... ވަނަ އިޞްލާޙު ގެނައުމުގެ ބިލު
summary: This bill amends the Maldives Pension Act (Law No. 8/2009) so that members of the Maldives Retirement Pension Scheme who have been diagnosed with a terminal illness can take money out of their retirement savings account for medical treatment. Normally these savings are paid out only on reaching pension age under Article 19 of the Act. The bill adds new Articles 32-1 and 32-2 after Article 32, which set the conditions: a specialist doctor's certificate, confirmation by a panel of three medical specialists, and a minimum balance tied to a MVR 2,000 monthly pension. Once approved, the whole balance in the account may be released.
whyItMatters: If passed, a pension scheme member facing a terminal illness could use their own retirement savings to pay for treatment and care before retirement age. The bill was rejected by a vote, so the existing rules still apply.
keyProvisions: Article 32-1 allows money in a member's retirement savings account to be released to a member who has a terminal illness, even though payouts are otherwise made only at pension age under Article 19(a) and (b).

Article 32-2(a) requires an official document from a specialist doctor registered with the Maldives Medical and Dental Council stating the member has a terminal illness, and confirmation of that document by a medical specialist panel.
Article 32-2(a)(3) also requires the member, when applying, to have enough in the account to equal the amount the scheme would pay out as MVR 2,000 a month at pension age.
Article 32-2(b) allows the entire balance of the applicant's retirement savings account to be released.

Article 32-2(c) and (d) require the Maldives Pension Administration to form a panel of 3 registered medical specialists, and the Pension Office board to publish regulations on the process and the panel, each within 3 months of the amendment taking effect.

Article 32-2(e) defines people with a terminal illness as those certified as such in an official document from a registered specialist doctor; Clause 2 says the law takes effect once passed, ratified and published in the Government Gazette.
whoIsAffected: Members of the Maldives Retirement Pension Scheme diagnosed with a terminal illness and their families, plus the Maldives Pension Administration and registered medical specialists.
statedReasons: The note says the bill lets pension scheme members diagnosed with a terminal illness draw on their retirement savings for long-term treatment, palliative care and psychological support, to ease the financial burden of treatment and simplify claims.
